description: This file defines the Coupons class, containing static methods for calculating various financial metrics related to bond coupons, such as coupon days, counts, and dates. It implements Excel financial functions for use within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Coupons
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate bond coupon related metrics such as coupon days, counts, and dates, integrating various date validation and calculation utilities.

methods.name: COUPDAYBS
methods.description: Calculates the number of days from the beginning of the coupon period to the settlement date, considering the basis and frequency.

methods.name: COUPDAYS
methods.description: Returns the number of days in the coupon period that contains the settlement date, based on the specified basis and frequency.

methods.name: COUPDAYSNC
methods.description: Calculates the number of days from the settlement date to the next coupon date.

methods.name: COUPNCD
methods.description: Gets the next coupon date after the settlement date.

methods.name: COUPNUM
methods.description: Returns the total number of coupons payable between the settlement and maturity dates.

methods.name: COUPPCD
methods.description: Gets the previous coupon date before the settlement date.
